capture_plan_law: One pipeline run per case; the four planted defect classes must be REJECTED and the production cases must PASS through this exact template path (prereg -> capture -> two-stage gate -> receipts -> review export). Declared views per K01 prereg section 9: normal player camera, detail of the hand/trunk contact region, alternate-angle of the grasp site, each in clean + diagnostic pairs; the approach terminal state and the recorded-config geometry state declare their reduced frame sets in the case table before the run.
exception_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 exception law: a frame passes only via an exception declared in the view-spec; every exception pass emits a machine receipt row with census evidence; prose-only exceptions are refused.
freeze_law_ref: VISUAL-GATE-1 prereg law: thresholds are frozen in the view-spec; the gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame; any change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash.
prereg_note: Authored BEFORE capture. This file pins the exact view-spec the K01 card will capture against; pipeline.run_pipeline refuses pre-render on any mismatch. The prereg file itself is hash-bound in every receipt and in the lane EVIDENCE.md. This capture prereg is subordinate to the committed experiment preregistration at tools/monkey_campaign/contributions/K01-CLIMB-20261001/PREREGISTRATION.md (commit cdfaa8cc1535dbe723097aa1277385aeb2aa79d3).
